goal: Tell a platform team, from one run of the kappa-conformance binary, whether their registry is ideal, conformant or not, and what exit code CI sees.

app.name: conformance-verdict
app.title: Conformance verdict
app.purpose: Decide, as a DMN decision table with hit policy FIRST, the verdict of a kappa-conformance run from whether its configuration was complete, whether the registry was reachable, and how many MUST failures and SHOULD warnings it recorded.
limits: It does not run the 149 tests; it decides from the counts a run reports.
Which conformance levels ran is set by KAPPA_TEST_LEVELS and is outside it.

fields.name: config
fields.means: whether KAPPA_REGISTRY_URL and the other required variables were set

fields.name: network
fields.means: whether the registry under test answered

meanings.ideal: no MUST failures and no SHOULD warnings; exit code 0
meanings.conformant: no MUST failures, some SHOULD warnings; exit code 0
meanings.nonconformant: one or more MUST tests failed; exit code 1
meanings.config-error: a required environment variable is missing; exit code 2
meanings.network-error: the registry under test was unreachable; exit code 3

rules.why: specs/draft/KAPPA_CONFORMANCE_SPEC.md 6.4: exit 2 is a configuration error
KAPPA_CONFORMANCE_SPEC.md 6.4: exit 3 is a network error
KAPPA_CONFORMANCE_SPEC.md 2.4 and 6.4: a MUST failure fails the run, exit 1
KAPPA_CONFORMANCE_SPEC.md 2.4: warnings appear in the report but do not affect the verdict

app.otherwiseWhy: KAPPA_CONFORMANCE_SPEC.md 2.4: no MUST failures and no SHOULD warnings is an ideal registry

properties.why: a MUST failure is never ideal
a MUST failure is never conformant
warnings alone never fail a reachable, configured run

stakeholders.name: Platform engineer
stakeholders.text: Builds the internal platform and its golden paths, and needs one honest verdict that a registry speaks kappa-distribution before teams depend on it.

stakeholders.name: Registry operator
stakeholders.text: Runs the registry day to day and needs CI to fail exactly when a MUST is broken, not on a warning.

concerns.name: Warnings never fail CI
concerns.text: A SHOULD warning shows in the report and never turns a conformant registry into a failed pipeline.

components.name: kappa-conformance
components.text: The static conformance binary: 149 tests across 5 levels, JUnit XML and HTML reports, exit codes 0 to 3.

components.name: kappa-registry
components.text: The single-binary registry for OCI, Git, S3, Nix and AT Protocol over one content-addressed store.

components.name: Prism page
components.text: The published GitHub Pages site: it checks the holo seal, sends the request to the verified guest in the browser and shows the answer in the reader's view.

components.name: Pipeline adapter
components.text: The CI step that sends the same request line to the same holo and fails the pipeline on the answer, so a pipeline and a person get one answer.

quality.text: Every run with a MUST failure is answered nonconformant.
quality.measureText: Runs with a MUST failure answered ideal or conformant.

quality.text: No run whose only findings are SHOULD warnings is answered nonconformant.
quality.measureText: Runs with no MUST failure, a good config and a reachable registry answered other than conformant or ideal.

threats.name: Warning promoted to failure
threats.text: A report treats a SHOULD warning as a MUST failure, so a conformant registry is blocked and teams route around the gate.

control.name: Proved verdict
control.text: Conformant is always the answer when config and network are fine and no MUST failed, proved for every request.
